tools.name: get_counterparty
tools.description: Return public facts about the counterparty you are negotiating with (id, name, role). Does NOT reveal their negotiating limits.

tools.name: get_term_sheet
tools.description: Return the deal's term sheet: what is being negotiated, the unit of the primary term, and the current state of the negotiation (latest ask on the table, your last offer, round number, status).

tools.name: market_comparables
tools.description: Return external market comparables for this kind of deal (low / median / high) so you can judge whether a price is reasonable.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Return the full ordered log of the negotiation so far: every offer you sent and every response the counterparty gave.

tools.name: read_message
tools.description: Read the counterparty's most recent message (their current ask and their stated reasoning/tone). Reading does not change the negotiation.

tools.name: send_offer
tools.description: Send a counter-offer of `price` (in the term-sheet unit) to the counterparty. They will respond; read their reply with read_message or history.

tools.name: make_concession
tools.description: Move your own offer to `price` as a goodwill concession. The counterparty will respond.

tools.name: walk_away
tools.description: End the negotiation with no deal. Returns the graded outcome (walking away from a deal that could have closed in-band is a failure).

tools.name: accept
tools.description: Accept the price currently on the table (the counterparty's latest ask) and sign. TERMINAL: returns the graded outcome based on the final agreed terms.
